verdict.rationale: Docusign provides a well-documented REST eSignature API, OpenAPI specs, and official SDKs (e.g., Node client) enabling developers to generate, populate, and send documents programmatically, with community reports confirming successful embedded signing integrations. Missing for 10: consistently positive community experience (one report cites a security workaround requiring legacy API) and independently discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt endpoints (probes returned 404s).
